TABLE.NAME: local_eventcalendar_calendar
TABLE.COMMENT: Calendar instances. Each row is an independently configurable calendar, created from a template or manually.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Display name of the calendar.

FIELD.NAME: templatekey
FIELD.COMMENT: Key of the source template (templates/definitions/*.json). Null for calendars created in custom mode.

FIELD.NAME: language
FIELD.COMMENT: Language of the calendar: code of one of the languages of the content packs (content_packs/{language}/). Together with templatekey it identifies the content pack that supplies the tagline and the day contents (and the texts that other plugins read from it). Null means no content pack is used.

FIELD.NAME: intro
FIELD.COMMENT: Introductory text shown on the list and detail pages.

FIELD.NAME: tagline
FIELD.COMMENT: Short text shown under the banner in the calendar grid, for example a call to action. Null or empty means no text. Separate from intro, which is a longer descriptive text.

FIELD.NAME: restdayenabled
FIELD.COMMENT: Weekly rest day enabled (1) or not (0). When enabled, days falling on the weekday set in restdayweekday use the rest texts of the content pack for the page content instead of the generic ones. Notifications are not affected.

FIELD.NAME: restdayweekday
FIELD.COMMENT: Weekday of the rest day, as in PHP date('w'): 0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday. Computed on the UTC date of the day. Only effective if restdayenabled = 1.

FIELD.NAME: startdate
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of the start of the countdown.

FIELD.NAME: enddate
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of the last content day.

FIELD.NAME: enddisplaydate
FIELD.COMMENT: Automatic hiding date: upper limit of the activation window. Always set. For calendars created from a template it defaults to enddate plus 20 days.

FIELD.NAME: progressiveunlock
FIELD.COMMENT: Progressive unlock flag: 1 = enabled, 0 = all days are always reachable.

FIELD.NAME: iconsetid
FIELD.COMMENT: Icon set used by the calendar.

FIELD.NAME: notificationsetid
FIELD.COMMENT: Notification set associated with the calendar. Null means no notifications configured.

FIELD.NAME: forcehide
FIELD.COMMENT: Manual override: 1 = always hidden regardless of the dates, 0 = follows the automatic activation from startdate to enddisplaydate. A copy or an imported calendar made by other plugins starts with forcehide = 1.

FIELD.NAME: bannerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Preloaded banner chosen for the {{banner}} placeholder of the email template. Null means no preloaded banner: other plugins can then provide an image (image_url hook).

FIELD.NAME: headerfooterid
FIELD.COMMENT: Preloaded header and footer pair chosen for the day content template ({{header}} and {{footer}} placeholders). Null means no preloaded pair: no header and footer, unless other plugins provide the images (image_url hook).

FIELD.NAME: emailtemplateid
FIELD.COMMENT: Email template used for the notification emails of this calendar. Null, or a template that no longer exists, means the default email template.

FIELD.NAME: usercreated
FIELD.COMMENT: User who created the record. Tracked separately because core\persistent only requires usermodified.

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Mandatory property of core\persistent.

INDEX.NAME: forcehide
INDEX.COMMENT: Speeds up the filter of active calendars in the site-wide list.

INDEX.NAME: iconsetid
INDEX.COMMENT: Calendars using an icon set (integrity checks before deletion).

INDEX.NAME: notificationsetid
INDEX.COMMENT: Calendars using a notification set.

INDEX.NAME: emailtemplateid
INDEX.COMMENT: Calendars using an email template.

TABLE.NAME: local_eventcalendar_banner
TABLE.COMMENT: Banners shipped with the plugin (pix/banners/{identifier}.{ext} and {identifier}.json), offered in the calendar form.

FIELD.NAME: identifier
FIELD.COMMENT: File name without extension in pix/banners/, also used to make the scan idempotent.

FIELD.NAME: filename
FIELD.COMMENT: Full file name, with extension, in pix/banners/.

FIELD.NAME: usercreated
FIELD.COMMENT: User who created the record (see local_eventcalendar_calendar).

TABLE.NAME: local_eventcalendar_headfoot
TABLE.COMMENT: Header and footer pairs shipped with the plugin (pix/headerfooters/ and headerfooters.json), offered in the calendar form for the day content template.

FIELD.NAME: identifier
FIELD.COMMENT: File name of the header without extension, used to make the scan idempotent. Internal key, not a displayed label.

FIELD.NAME: headerfilename
FIELD.COMMENT: Full file name, with extension, of the header in pix/headerfooters/.

FIELD.NAME: footerfilename
FIELD.COMMENT: Full file name, with extension, of the footer in pix/headerfooters/.

FIELD.NAME: usercreated
FIELD.COMMENT: User who created the record (see local_eventcalendar_calendar).

TABLE.NAME: local_eventcalendar_days
TABLE.COMMENT: Days of a calendar, merged with the day content: one row per day.

FIELD.NAME: calendarid
FIELD.COMMENT: Calendar the day belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: daynumber
FIELD.COMMENT: Sequential number of the day (for example 1 to 24 for Advent). Also sets the display order.

FIELD.NAME: opendate
FIELD.COMMENT: Unlock timestamp of the day, used both for the icon state and for the progressive unlock.

FIELD.NAME: notiftitle
FIELD.COMMENT: Notification title for this day (plain text), copied from the title pool of the notification set when the calendar is generated. Detached from the set. Null if no set was selected or if it was cleared manually.

FIELD.NAME: notifbody
FIELD.COMMENT: Notification body for this day (HTML), copied from the body pool of the notification set. Images included in the body are not duplicated as files of this day, so the copied text may contain URLs pointing to files of the original notification set.

FIELD.NAME: notifbodyformat
FIELD.COMMENT: Format of notifbody, Moodle FORMAT_* constants.

FIELD.NAME: content
FIELD.COMMENT: HTML content shown on the day detail page, editable with the HTML editor. Copied from the content pack when the calendar is generated, if available; otherwise empty.

FIELD.NAME: contentformat
FIELD.COMMENT: Format of content, Moodle FORMAT_* constants.

FIELD.NAME: isready
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the calendar manager considers this day ready (1) or still in progress (0, default). Only an indication: it does not block publishing or sending notifications.

FIELD.NAME: notes
FIELD.COMMENT: Free notes for the calendar manager (plain text), never shown to end users.

FIELD.NAME: usercreated
FIELD.COMMENT: User who created the record (see local_eventcalendar_calendar).

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Mandatory property of core\persistent.

INDEX.NAME: calendarid_daynumber
INDEX.COMMENT: A calendar cannot have two days with the same day number.

FIELD.NAME: source
FIELD.COMMENT: Allowed values: standard, custom.

FIELD.NAME: identifier
FIELD.COMMENT: For source = standard: folder name in pix/iconsets/. For source = custom: internal slug; custom sets are managed by other plugins, which keep their files.

FIELD.NAME: usercreated
FIELD.COMMENT: User who created the record (see local_eventcalendar_calendar).

INDEX.NAME: source_identifier
INDEX.COMMENT: Prevents duplicates of the same standard or custom icon set.

FIELD.NAME: iconsetid
FIELD.COMMENT: Icon set the icon belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: filename
FIELD.COMMENT: Image file name: for source = custom it is the name of the uploaded file, for source = standard it is the file name in pix/iconsets/{identifier}/.

FIELD.NAME: usercreated
FIELD.COMMENT: User who created the record (see local_eventcalendar_calendar).

INDEX.NAME: iconsetid
INDEX.COMMENT: Icons of a set.

TABLE.NAME: local_eventcalendar_emailtpl
TABLE.COMMENT: Email format: fixed HTML wrapper (header, button, footer) with placeholders such as {{content}}, into which the notification content is inserted when sending.

FIELD.NAME: language
FIELD.COMMENT: Language code (for example it, en), matching the subfolder name in email_templates/.

FIELD.NAME: identifier
FIELD.COMMENT: File name without extension in email_templates/{language}/, used to make the scan idempotent.

FIELD.NAME: content
FIELD.COMMENT: HTML of the template, with placeholders {{content}}, {{firstname}}, {{calendarname}}, {{daynumber}}, {{linkurl}}, {{sitename}}, {{siteurl}}, {{logo}}, {{banner}}, {{year}}. The scan never overwrites it once the row exists.

FIELD.NAME: isdefault
FIELD.COMMENT: Fallback template when none exists for the recipient language. Only one record can have it set to 1.

FIELD.NAME: source
FIELD.COMMENT: Origin of the template: file = imported by the scan of email_templates/ with its content unchanged; custom = created or changed by other means (copy, content edited, imported with a calendar).

FIELD.NAME: usercreated
FIELD.COMMENT: User who created the record (see local_eventcalendar_calendar).

INDEX.NAME: language_identifier
INDEX.COMMENT: Avoids importing the same source file twice.

TABLE.NAME: local_eventcalendar_log
TABLE.COMMENT: Log of day openings, used for the visited state and for reporting.

INDEX.NAME: dayid_userid
INDEX.COMMENT: Frequent query: does a log exist for this user on this day (icon state).

INDEX.NAME: calendarid
INDEX.COMMENT: Openings of a calendar (reports).

INDEX.NAME: userid
INDEX.COMMENT: Openings of a user (privacy).

TABLE.NAME: local_eventcalendar_sent
TABLE.COMMENT: Day notifications handled by the sending task (classes/task/send_notifications.php): one row per day and user, so that the same notification is not sent twice.

FIELD.NAME: timesent
FIELD.COMMENT: Time of sending; null if the notification was not sent.

FIELD.NAME: attempts
FIELD.COMMENT: Sending attempts. With timesent null: 0 = skipped (invalid email address), 1 = failed once, retried by the next run, 2 = failed twice, not retried.

INDEX.NAME: dayid_userid
INDEX.COMMENT: One notification per day and per person.

INDEX.NAME: calendarid
INDEX.COMMENT: Notifications of a calendar.

INDEX.NAME: userid
INDEX.COMMENT: Notifications of a user (privacy).

TABLE.NAME: local_eventcalendar_notif
TABLE.COMMENT: Notifications: a collection of contents belonging to a set, split into two independent pools by kind (titles and bodies), not paired.

FIELD.NAME: setid
FIELD.COMMENT: Notification set the notification belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: kind
FIELD.COMMENT: 'title' (title for Moodle messaging or email subject, plain text) or 'body' (message body, HTML with images). Independent pools within the same set.

FIELD.NAME: defaultmessage
FIELD.COMMENT: Content: plain title if kind = title, HTML (possibly with images) if kind = body. For email sending, image URLs in the body must be regenerated with a per-user token (moodle_url::make_pluginfile_url with includetoken = true) to be reachable without login.

FIELD.NAME: defaultmessageformat
FIELD.COMMENT: Format of the content, Moodle FORMAT_* constants. Relevant only for kind = body (titles are always plain text).

FIELD.NAME: usercreated
FIELD.COMMENT: User who created the record (see local_eventcalendar_calendar).

INDEX.NAME: setid_kind
INDEX.COMMENT: Speeds up the separate retrieval of the two pools (titles and bodies) of a set.

TABLE.NAME: local_eventcalendar_notifset
TABLE.COMMENT: Notification sets: containers of notifications of their own.

FIELD.NAME: sourcepack
FIELD.COMMENT: Key of the standard content pack the set was imported from (format 'language:template_key', for example 'it:advent'). Null for sets created from scratch. Used only for idempotence: avoids offering an already imported pack again.

FIELD.NAME: sourcepackversion
FIELD.COMMENT: Pack version at import time (field 'version' in the JSON, default 1 if missing). Compared with the current version on disk to detect updated packs. Null if sourcepack is null.

FIELD.NAME: usercreated
FIELD.COMMENT: User who created the record (see local_eventcalendar_calendar).

TABLE.NAME: local_eventcalendar_subscr
TABLE.COMMENT: User subscriptions to the notifications of a calendar.

INDEX.NAME: calendarid_userid
INDEX.COMMENT: A missing record means unsubscribed; one record per calendar and user pair.

INDEX.NAME: userid
INDEX.COMMENT: Subscriptions of a user (privacy).

TABLE.NAME: local_eventcalendar_datelook
TABLE.COMMENT: Single lookup table for lunar and lunisolar dates, shared by all templates.

FIELD.NAME: templatekey
FIELD.COMMENT: Key of the template the date refers to (for example chinese_newyear).

FIELD.NAME: eventyear
FIELD.COMMENT: Calendar year the resolved date refers to.

FIELD.NAME: eventdate
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of the date resolved for that year and template.

FIELD.NAME: usercreated
FIELD.COMMENT: User who created the record (see local_eventcalendar_calendar).

INDEX.NAME: templatekey_eventyear
INDEX.COMMENT: One date per template and year.

TABLE.NAME: local_eventcalendar_rulegrp
TABLE.COMMENT: Blocks of access conditions of a calendar.

FIELD.NAME: calendarid
FIELD.COMMENT: Calendar the block applies to.

FIELD.NAME: sortorder
FIELD.COMMENT: Display order in the rules page. Does not affect the evaluation (OR).

INDEX.NAME: calendarid
INDEX.COMMENT: Blocks of conditions of a calendar.

TABLE.NAME: local_eventcalendar_rule
TABLE.COMMENT: Single access condition inside a block.

FIELD.NAME: groupid
FIELD.COMMENT: Block the condition belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: calendarid
FIELD.COMMENT: Redundant with the block: allows reading all the conditions of a calendar with a single query.

FIELD.NAME: ruletype
FIELD.COMMENT: Condition type: role and cohort in this plugin, or a type registered by another plugin.

FIELD.NAME: subject
FIELD.COMMENT: Item the condition refers to, as text, interpreted by the type (for example the id of a role or of a cohort).

FIELD.NAME: comparison
FIELD.COMMENT: Comparison operator (is, isnot, equals, contains, before...). The field is not named operator to avoid SQL reserved words.

FIELD.NAME: value
FIELD.COMMENT: Value to compare, only for the types and operators that need it. Dates in YYYY-MM-DD format.

FIELD.NAME: sortorder
FIELD.COMMENT: Display order in the block. Does not affect the evaluation (AND).

INDEX.NAME: ruletype_subject
INDEX.COMMENT: Finds the conditions referring to a given item (for example a deleted cohort).

INDEX.NAME: groupid
INDEX.COMMENT: Conditions of a block.

INDEX.NAME: calendarid
INDEX.COMMENT: Conditions of a calendar.
